capture_limitations.text: Capture follows delta-to-cumulative and batch processors; it does not establish receiver input temporality.

Inventory labels are a compatibility union of native resource and datapoint keys. The artifact remains authoritative for placement, scope and schema URLs; native-envelope tests verify emitted placement separately.
This Kubernetes path does not establish a standalone host path.
Earlier post-gateway evidence is a separately attributed translated metric with unknown instrument evidence and different key presence.
Grafana Alloy exposes metrics and traces outputs for this component, but no logs output; logs are outside this receiver path.

source.instrument_type_source: Decoded from the retained native OTLP Metric data-shape field. Gauge records inventory gauge. The 86 non-monotonic cumulative Sums use inventory gauge only as a compatibility category; their actual OTLP kind, cumulative temporality, monotonicity, scope and resource-versus-datapoint placement remain in the authoritative native-envelope artifact.
